name: train-cs-sk-focal-r3
description:
RQ6, the final-model candidate that joins two development results: train-cs-sk-focal
(gliner's focal loss, alpha 0.75, gamma 2; best on UNER-SK) with every CNEC 2.0 and
UNER Slovak-SNK train example repeated 3x (6,924 of 26,924 examples, the rest 10,000
from each OpenPII 1M split), the recipe with which every ce seed found the REDACT
record the 1x runs miss (stage B). 2,000 steps of 16, as both parents. Trained on
MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md).
